subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `tools.swarm`, collector persistence, and `agents_wait` as an experimental core contract now, or should the feature remain narrowed until its durable restart and API semantics are approved?
rationale: This PR creates a broad, persisted agent-orchestration contract that cannot be accepted solely from code-level correctness; the protected maintainer label and umbrella proposal require explicit ownership of the long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core experiment
options.body: Approve the core direction once the durable launch reconciliation and real restart proof establish the stated collector contract.

options.title: Narrow before landing
options.body: Limit this PR to a smaller generic seam or bounded experimental subset while the remaining Swarm surfaces are designed separately.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Keep the umbrella direction open and postpone this public config/tool contract until maintainers choose the permanent orchestration model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated core experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction once the durable launch reconciliation and real restart proof establish the stated collector contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR context identifies steipete as the author of the frozen Swarm specification and the implementation owner across the affected surfaces.
